title: Controlled Knowledge Engineering for Taxonomy Induction with Tool-Grounded LLM Agents and Runtime-Adaptive Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.13966v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Taxonomies are structured knowledge representations that support semantic search, recommendation, product catalog organization, and retrieval-augmented generation. Their automated construction from a fixed set of candidate entities requires more than plausible text generation: the resulting hierarchy must be complete, structurally valid, and semantically coherent. Large Language Models (LLMs) are promising for this task, but iterative free-form generation remains vulnerable to omitted or hallucinated entities, invalid hierarchical relations, and inconsistent organizational principles. We introduce TIGA (Taxonomy Induction with Tool-Grounded Agents), a knowledge-engineering architecture that formulates taxonomy induction as an iterative decision process over an explicit state and constrained action space. translated_title: 基于工具锚定LLM智能体与运行时自适应策略的分类体系归纳受控知识工程
translated_abstract: 分类体系是一类结构化的知识表示，可支持语义搜索、推荐、产品目录组织以及检索增强生成。从固定的候选实体集合自动构建分类体系，所需的远不止看似合理的文本生成：所得的层次结构必须完整、结构有效且语义连贯。大型语言模型（LLM）在这项任务上前景可观，但迭代式的自由形式生成仍容易出现实体遗漏或幻觉、无效的层次关系以及不一致的组织原则等问题。我们提出了TIGA（Taxonomy Induction with Tool-Grounded Agents，基于工具锚定智能体的分类体系归纳），这是一种知识工程架构，它将分类体系归纳形式化为在显式状态与受约束动作空间上的迭代决策过程。TIGA结合了可执行的分类体系编辑工具、记录工具调用、理由与结果的记忆机制，以及运行时自适应的策略。
tldr: 本文提出TIGA架构，将分类体系归纳形式化为显式状态与受约束动作空间上的迭代决策过程，借助可执行的分类编辑工具、记录调用与理由的记忆机制以及运行时自适应策略，克服LLM自由生成中的实体幻觉与无效层次关系，实现完整、结构有效且语义连贯的自动分类体系构建。
en_tdlr: TIGA formulates taxonomy induction as an iterative decision process over explicit states and a constrained action space, combining executable taxonomy-editing tools, memory of tool calls and rationales, and runtime-adaptive policies to build complete, structurally valid, and semantically coherent taxonomies while avoiding LLM hallucination and invalid hierarchies.
